title: Continuous local deformation classes and normalized conormal comparison objects
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field]. Use the marked Artinian test algebras of [def-sfb-artin-deformation-test-category] and the marked flat algebra deformation groupoids of [def-sfb-marked-flat-algebra-deformations]. The dual-number test is the split square-zero algebra $k\oplus k\epsilon$ with its standard augmentation and $\epsilon=(0,1)$. For a local commutative $k$-algebra $A$, write $B=\widehat A_{\mathfrak m_A}$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. For any commutative $k$-algebra $H$, the continuous deformation groupoid at a test algebra $R$ is the full subgroupoid of marked flat deformations of $H$ consisting of complete Noetherian local algebras [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]; arrows are marked isomorphisms, automatically continuous for maximal-ideal-adic topologies. First-order classes are the quotient by marked isomorphism of the respective groupoids at the dual-number test. A finite localized polynomial presentation is a surjective presentation $P\to A$ in the record of [def-trf-naive-cotangent-comparison-data], where $P$ is a localization of $k[x_1,\ldots,x_r]$ for some finite $r$, compatibly with the base map. Use that node's actual conormal module $J/J^2$, differential module $A\otimes_P\Omega^1_{P/k}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], and differential. Represent $C=[J/J^2\to A\otimes_P\Omega^1_{P/k}]$ by the cone of the degree-zero differential and represent $\widehat C$ by the cone of its scalar-extended differential over $B$. The tangent Hom spaces are $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(A)}(C,A[1])$ and $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(B)}(\widehat C,B[1])$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], using the positive quotient and boundary of [def-sfb-two-term-derived-hom-boundary-maps]. A relation map $\phi:J/J^2\to A$ of a dual-number deformation $Q$ means there is a $k$-algebra lift $a:P\to Q$ of its presentation such that $a(j)=\epsilon e$ whenever the marking sends $e$ to $\phi([j])$. A completed relation map is a $B$-linear map $B\otimes_A J/J^2\to B$ satisfying the same rule on $1\otimes[j]$ for a lift $P\to Q$ of $P\to A\to B$. Its scalar extension is specified by $b\otimes[j]\mapsto b\phi([j])$. A conormal square of a presentation map consists of the induced maps on conormal classes and differential tensors, with their commuting-square identity; it induces the standard cone map and its scalar-extended cone map. Complete the presentation ring and its polynomial differential module at the inverse image of $\mathfrak m_A$; write $\widehat{dx}$ for the image of $dx$ in that completed module. These are constructions and predicates, with no assertion about ordinary differentials of $B/k$.
